## [0.14.17](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/compare/v0.14.16...v0.14.17) (2026-10-28)


### Performance Improvements

* a session never pays a cache bust for bytes it is not riding ([#165](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/165)) ([8903249](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/890324909b10a1156bb7542d0b1f618aae3ae3c7)), closes [#162](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/162) [pre-#162](https://github.com/pre-/issues/162)

## [0.14.16](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/compare/v0.14.15...v0.14.16) (2026-10-28)


### Bug Fixes

* a memory write must not bust the prompt cache unless bytes move ([#162](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/162)) ([2072297](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/2072297ffd96b75baf2195b7ef4c2b24c8c37791))

### Bug Fixes

### Bug Fixes

* **security:** an unresolved session has no write target ([#152](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/152)) ([e1256e0](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/e1256e0ae6552306bf9b3e9860364b9ff9e39868)), closes [127/#133](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/133)

### Bug Fixes

* **security:** date-shaped evidence reads, ownership-checked merges, redact-before-crop capture ([bc9eebd](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/bc9eebdeb63fdcba14877f4b45b7dc48f67353e1)), closes [#130](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/130) [#131](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/131) [#132](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/132) [#130](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/130) [#131](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/131) [#127](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/127) [#125](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/125) [#132](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/132)
